description: This file contains utility functions for managing an SQLite database for a notes application, including database initialization, CRUD operations for notes, and helper functions for handling database rows.

methods.name: str _utc_now_iso()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time as an ISO-8601 string with a 'Z' suffix.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Determines the filesystem path to the SQLite database, based on environment variable or default location.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _dict_factory(cursor: sqlite3.Cursor, row: sqlite3.Row)
methods.description: SQLite row_factory that converts rows into dictionaries keyed by column names.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Creates a new SQLite connection with row factory set and foreign keys enabled.

methods.name: None init_db()
methods.description: Ensures the notes table exists in the database, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] note_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row dictionary into a standardized output dictionary for API purposes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_note(title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns the created note data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID, returns None if not found.

methods.name: list[Dict[str,Any]] list_notes()
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes ordered by updated_at and then id.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new title and/or content; returns the updated note or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returns True if a note was deleted.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(title: str, content: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str/
